sections.title: A family *tradition*

image.alt: The Tucker Orthodontics doctors and team gathered in the office

body: Dr. John W. Tucker, Sr. began caring for Aiken smiles in 1967. Today his sons, Dr. John W. Tucker, Jr. and Dr. Perry S. Tucker, carry on the practice.

Dr. John Tucker has spent more than 20 years helping patients see what treatment can do for them. Dr. Perry Tucker has lived in Aiken all his life and trained at the University of South Carolina, the Medical University of South Carolina and the University of Pennsylvania.

items.q: When should my child first see an orthodontist?
items.a: The American Association of Orthodontists recommends a first visit around age seven.

items.q: Am I too old for braces?
items.a: No. About one in every five orthodontic patients is over 21, and any age can be a great age to start.
